accepted.role: Four cosmetic crew appearances, each with four directions
accepted.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for an original 2.5D space-adventure RPG in Godot, not a mockup. Generate a single square 1024x1024 PNG with TRUE transparent background. EXACT layout: 4 equal columns x 4 equal rows, each cell 256x256, no gridlines, no labels, no text. Every cell has one complete full-body character, bottom of boots aligned at cell local y=240, top around y=24, centered x=128, at same consistent scale, generous padding. All sprites are viewed from a slightly elevated RPG camera, crisp beautifully shaded pixel art, high-end 32-bit JRPG craftsmanship, 3-head-tall heroic proportions, exquisite metal highlights and fabric shading, strong readable silhouette, deliberate color clusters and dark outline, roughly 64x80 native pixel aesthetic enlarged cleanly, no blurry airbrushing. Columns in EVERY row are: column1 FRONT facing viewer (slight three-quarter acceptable), column2 BACK away from viewer, column3 LEFT profile facing screen left, column4 RIGHT profile facing screen right. Same character and equipment across its row. Neutral relaxed standing pose, arms visible, feet planted, no weapons firing, no shadows outside the sprite, no ground, no scenery, no UI.
Row1: expedition captain, charismatic original woman with long swept silver-blue hair, navy fitted exploration suit with rich teal shoulder cape/scarf falling behind, amber belt, pale armor panels at knees and forearms, glowing cyan wrist scanner, visible expressive warm brown face. Adventurous Zelda-like character appeal translated into original science fiction, no existing character copied.
Row2: classic NASA-style EVA astronaut, bulky off-white fabric pressure suit, round helmet with beautiful reflective amber-gold opaque visor, red upper-arm identification bands, chest life support controls and hose, padded knees, sturdy moon boots, white rectangular oxygen backpack, no logos.
Row3: powered-suit engineer, original futuristic orange/copper and deep purple segmented exosuit, striking large rounded shoulder pauldrons, sleek angular helmet with luminous green visor, small cyan chest core, armored boots, mechanical tool gauntlet. Powerful athletic silhouette like a space bounty hunter but original design, no exact existing character.
Row4: original ivory-armored space sentinel with dark graphite undersuit, angular white helmet and narrow blue visor, asymmetric blue left shoulder panel, detailed chest plates and joint segmentation, utility belt, white shin armor, heroic friendly proportions. Storm-trooper-like armor language but distinct original helmet, no logos, no gun.
Requirements: sixteen precisely centered sprites in fixed uniform cells. Each silhouette must remain entirely within its cell. Transparent background everywhere outside characters, no checkerboard baked in. Pixel craftsmanship and consistent anatomy more important than photorealism. This atlas will be used directly as in-game sprites.

rejected.prompt: Edit this production sprite atlas for the next walking animation frame. Preserve the exact four characters, pixel art, palettes, materials, body scale, four-by-four grid, cell centers, all four directions in each row, alpha transparency, and canvas dimensions. Change only the standing poses to a restrained walking contact pose: one boot forward and the other back, bent knees, opposite arm gently counter-swinging; backpack and cape respond subtly. Keep every boot baseline and head height consistent with its original cell, no character extending outside its cell. The EVA astronaut has a weighty moon-walk stride; power armor has a firm mechanical stride; captain has a light adventurer stride; sentinel a disciplined stride. All four columns remain front, back, left profile, right profile. Do not mirror or reorder characters. Do not add elements, weapons, shadows, backgrounds, labels or UI. Clean any stray colored halo pixels outside the silhouettes; use true transparency. This is a directly consumed animation atlas, not a presentation sheet.

Background extraction only. Return this exact 4x4 walking sprite atlas as a PNG with a REAL ALPHA CHANNEL. The input currently has an opaque black background: remove all that background around and between the sixteen characters to true alpha=0. Preserve every character, their dark outlines and interior dark suit parts, all poses, positions, cell alignment, scale, colors, canvas size and pixel details. Do not repaint or redesign anything. No black background, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no ground shadow, no text. Deliver an actual transparent cutout sprite sheet suitable for Sprite3D.

Use transparent image output (background=transparent, PNG with alpha), as in the attached source. This source already has correct alpha transparency: preserve its transparent layer exactly, never fill it with black, white or a checkerboard. Change ONLY the leg and arm poses of all sixteen sprites into a walking contact pose, one foot forward and the other back with a slight opposite arm swing. All identities, equipment, color palette, scale, orientation, row/column placement and the 4x4 layout must remain identical. Keep the 1254x1254 canvas size and existing foot baselines. No scene, no ground, no shadows outside the figures. This is a game asset cutout; the output must have genuinely transparent pixels around each figure.
